## Positions

- **Since 2003** — Associate Professor (Maîtresse de conférences), Université Paris Nanterre; *hors classe* since 2024.
- **Since 2014** — Associate researcher, [LAMSADE](https://www.lamsade.dauphine.fr) (UMR CNRS 7243), Université Paris Dauphine–PSL.
- **2004–2010** — Associate Professor, ESTI (now ENICarthage), Tunis.
- **2002–2004** — Postdoctoral researcher, then research consultant, Crédit Commercial de France (HSBC group), Paris.
- **2000–2002** — Teaching and research assistant (ATER), IUT de Villetaneuse, Université Paris 13.
